description.$value: Spacing tokens for the Spacious density mode — increased whitespace for comfortable reading and interaction. Values derived from base primitives × spacious multiplier with corrector offsets where needed.

px.$description: Minimal density spacing. Absolute (px) — does not change on mode switch. Use for tight fixed-size gaps between dense elements.
Small density spacing. Absolute (px) — does not change on mode switch. Use for compact fixed gaps and fine element separation.
Medium density spacing. Absolute (px) — does not change on mode switch. Use for standard fixed component padding.
Large density spacing. Absolute (px) — does not change on mode switch. Use for comfortable fixed spacing with improved legibility.
Extra-large density spacing. Absolute (px) — does not change on mode switch. Use for generous fixed component padding.
2XL density spacing. Absolute (px) — does not change on mode switch. Use for spacious fixed content separation.
3XL density spacing. Absolute (px) — does not change on mode switch. Use for prominent fixed visual breaks.
4XL density spacing. Absolute (px) — does not change on mode switch. Use for significant fixed section separation.
5XL density spacing. Absolute (px) — does not change on mode switch. Use for generous fixed separation in spacious areas.
6XL density spacing. Absolute (px) — does not change on mode switch. Use for large fixed visual breaks between content groups.
7XL density spacing. Absolute (px) — does not change on mode switch. Use for major fixed section spacing.
8XL density spacing. Absolute (px) — does not change on mode switch. Use for substantial fixed layout separation.
9XL density spacing. Absolute (px) — does not change on mode switch. Use for wide fixed spacing between major layout elements.
10XL density spacing. Absolute (px) — does not change on mode switch. Use for expansive fixed page-level separation.
11XL density spacing. Absolute (px) — does not change on mode switch. Use for maximum fixed density spacing and prominent page-level gaps.
